TITLE — typeset this exact headline, large, high-contrast, in the vertical middle 60% of the frame. No other words, no byline, no watermark, no logo:
One .tmux.conf line per real annoyance: the config that grows up

SUBJECT
The next .tmux.conf lines worth adding once tmux sticks — vi copy-mode, system-clipboard yank, renumber-on-close, and a status bar that isn't an eyesore.

NOTES
The survival subset ends with a six line and a promise: every line earns its place, no theme soup. That config is correct and it is enough to live in tmux. Then you live in tmux for two weeks, and a few small things start to grate. Not bugs — papercuts. You hit in copy mode and nothing scrolls. You select an error message, paste it into your browser, and get last week's clipboard instead. You close window 2 of three and live with a gap until you restart. The default status bar glows the same rad
